description: Core/Business layer: DTOs (all modules), domain models (CDS + ReferenceRange), service interfaces, and all service implementations including the CDS engine, reference-range parser, safety-check service, admin seeder, JWT token service, and audit log service. Depends on FEAT-001 (entities + repos must exist). Independent of FEAT-003 (controllers).

17. Implement DCDSS/Services/ReferenceRangeParser.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IReferenceRangeParser. Pure, singleton.
    ParseNumericValue(string resultValue): Trim input. If matches Regex @"^[<>]\s*([\d.]+)" capture group 1 and parse as double. Else try double.TryParse → return parsed value or null for qualitative strings.
    ParseRange(string referenceRange): Trim. Try match Regex @"^([\d.]+)\s*-\s*([\d.]+)(?:\s*(.+))?$" → Min=g1, Max=g2, Unit=g3?.Trim(). Else try @"^<\s*([\d.]+)(?:\s*(.+))?$" → Max=g1, Unit=g2?. Else try @"^>\s*([\d.]+)(?:\s*(.+))?$" → Min=g1, Unit=g2?. Else return ReferenceRangeParseResult { Min=null, Max=null, Unit=null }.
    Classify(string resultValue, string referenceRange): Step 1 — if Regex.IsMatch(resultValue.Trim(), @"^[<>]\s*\d") return LabResultStatus.Indeterminate. Step 2 — val = ParseNumericValue(resultValue); if val == null return Indeterminate. Step 3 — parsed = ParseRange(referenceRange). If both Min and Max: val<Min→Low, val>Max→High, else Normal. If Max only ("<X" form): val>=Max→High else Normal. If Min only (">X" form): val<=Min→Low else Normal. Else Indeterminate.

18. Implement DCDSS/Services/ClinicalRuleStore.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IClinicalRuleStore. Singleton. Contains all seed rules from design Section 6. Hardcode them as private static readonly IList<T> fields. GetDiagnosticRules() returns a list with DIA-001, DIA-002, DIA-003. GetDrugInteractionPairs() returns INT-001 through INT-004. GetAllergyConflicts() returns ALG-001, ALG-002a, ALG-002b, ALG-003. GetCriticalLabRules() returns LAB-001, LAB-002, LAB-003. GetDrugLabConflictRules() returns DLC-001, DLC-002, DLC-003. See design Section 6 for exact values of all rule fields.

19. Implement DCDSS/Services/CdsRuleEvaluator.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements ICdsRuleEvaluator. Constructor(IClinicalRuleStore ruleStore, IReferenceRangeParser parser). Pure Evaluate(CdsEvaluationInput input) → CdsEvaluationResult:
    Normalize helpers (all comparisons OrdinalIgnoreCase Trim): normMeds = input.Medications deduplicated (case-insensitive); normAllergies = input.Allergies deduplicated; normSymptoms = input.Symptoms deduplicated. LatestLabsDict = build Dictionary<string, LabResultInput> from input.LabResults keyed by TestName (OrdinalIgnoreCase).
    Diagnostic rules: foreach rule, count how many TriggerSymptoms are contained in normSymptoms (case-insensitive Trim Contains). If count >= MinSymptomMatches → CdsFinding { RuleId=rule.Id, Type=Diagnostic, Severity=rule.Severity, Title=rule.Name, Description=rule.SuggestedDiagnosis } → DiagnosticRecommendations.
    Drug-drug interactions: foreach pair, if normMeds contains DrugA AND DrugB → CdsFinding { Type=Interaction, Severity, Title=$"Drug Interaction: {DrugA} + {DrugB}", Description, RelatedItem=DrugB } → InteractionWarnings.
    Allergy conflicts: foreach rule, if normAllergies contains Allergen (exact OrdinalIgnoreCase) AND any of Drugs is in normMeds → CdsFinding { Type=Allergy, Severity, Title=rule.Description, Description=rule.Description, RelatedItem=matched Drug } → CriticalAlerts.
    Critical lab rules: foreach rule, foreach lab in LatestLabsDict where key contains rule.TestName (OrdinalIgnoreCase), val = parser.ParseNumericValue(lab.ResultValue); if val != null and (val < rule.CriticalLow OR val > rule.CriticalHigh) → CdsFinding { Type=CriticalLab, Severity, Title=$"Critical Lab Value: {lab.TestName}", Description=rule.Description } → CriticalAlerts.
    Drug-lab conflicts: foreach rule, drug in normMeds that equals rule.Drug (OrdinalIgnoreCase Trim). If found, look up lab in LatestLabsDict by rule.LabTest (OrdinalIgnoreCase key Contains). val = ParseNumericValue. If val != null and ((rule.Operator=="<" && val<rule.Threshold)||(rule.Operator==">" && val>rule.Threshold)) → CdsFinding { Type=DrugLab, Severity, Title=$"{rule.Drug}: {rule.LabTest} conflict", Description=rule.Description, RelatedItem=rule.Drug } → InteractionWarnings.

20. Implement DCDSS/Services/SafetyCheckService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements ISafetyCheckService. Constructor(IClinicalRuleStore ruleStore, ILabResultRepository labResultRepo, IMedicationRepository medicationRepo, IPatientAllergyRepository allergyRepo, IReferenceRangeParser parser). CheckPrescriptionAsync: load active meds via medicationRepo.GetActiveByPatientAsync(patientId); if excludeMedicationId != null filter it out. Load allergies via allergyRepo.GetByPatientAsync(patientId). Load lab results via labResultRepo.GetByPatientAsync(patientId). Compute latestLabs = LabResultSelector.LatestPerTest(labs). var conflicts = new List<SafetyConflict>().
    Drug-drug: foreach active med m, check ruleStore.GetDrugInteractionPairs() where (DrugA matches newDrug AND DrugB matches m.DrugName) OR (DrugB matches newDrug AND DrugA matches m.DrugName). Add SafetyConflict { RuleId, Type=Interaction, Severity, Message=pair.Description, RelatedDrug=m.DrugName }.
    Drug-allergy: foreach allergyConflict in ruleStore.GetAllergyConflicts(), if allergies contains rule.Allergen AND any of rule.Drugs matches newDrug → SafetyConflict { RuleId, Type=Allergy, Severity, Message=rule.Description, RelatedAllergen=rule.Allergen }.
    Drug-lab: foreach dlcRule where dlcRule.Drug matches newDrug, look up latestLabs for dlcRule.LabTest (OrdinalIgnoreCase Contains on TestName), val = parser.ParseNumericValue(lab.ResultValue). If condition fires → SafetyConflict { RuleId, Type=DrugLab, Severity, Message=rule.Description, RelatedDrug=dlcRule.Drug }.
    Allowed = !conflicts.Any(c => c.Severity == CdsSeverity.Critical). return new SafetyCheckResult { Allowed, Conflicts = conflicts }.

21. Implement DCDSS/Services/CdsEngine.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements ICdsEngine. Constructor(IPatientAllergyRepository allergyRepo, IMedicationRepository medicationRepo, ILabResultRepository labResultRepo, ICdsRuleEvaluator evaluator, IRepository<Patient> patientRepo). EvaluateAsync(CdsEvaluationRequestDto request):
    Start with explicit inputs from request (may be null, default to empty lists).
    If request.PatientId has value: load allergies, active meds via records, lab results via labResultRepo. Compute latestStoredLabs = LabResultSelector.LatestPerTest(storedLabs).
    Build merge:
      - Lab dict seed from latestStoredLabs (mapped to LabResultInput), then overlay explicit request.LabResults (explicit wins per TestName key, OrdinalIgnoreCase).
      - Medications: union stored active med DrugNames + explicit request.Medications?.Select(m=>m.DrugName), deduplicate OrdinalIgnoreCase Trim.
      - Allergies: union stored allergen strings + explicit request.Allergies, deduplicate OrdinalIgnoreCase Trim.
      - Symptoms: explicit request.Symptoms (no stored symptoms), deduplicate OrdinalIgnoreCase Trim.
    Build CdsEvaluationInput { Symptoms, LabResults=mergedDict.Values.ToList(), Medications=mergedMeds, Allergies=mergedAllergies }.
    result = evaluator.Evaluate(input).
    Map to CdsEvaluationResponseDto: findings with Type=Diagnostic → DiagnosticRecommendations; Type=Interaction or DrugLab → InteractionWarnings; Type=Allergy or CriticalLab → CriticalAlerts. Each finding maps to CdsFindingDto. EvaluatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow.

22. Implement DCDSS/Services/TokenService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements ITokenService. Constructor(IOptions<JwtSettings> opts). GenerateToken(User user): create JwtSecurityToken with claims { sub=user.UserId.ToString(), role=user.Role.ToString(), name=user.Username }, SigningCredentials(SymmetricSecurityKey(UTF8.GetBytes(SigningKey)), SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256), Issuer, Audience, Expires=DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(ExpiryMinutes). Return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token).

23. Implement DCDSS/Services/AuthService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IAuthService. Constructor(IUserRepository userRepo, IUnitOfWork uow, PasswordHasher<User> hasher). RegisterAsync: check uniqueness via userRepo.GetByUsernameAsync and GetByEmailAsync → throw ConflictException if dup. Create User entity, hash password, AddAsync, SaveChangesAsync. Return UserDto mapped from entity. LoginAsync: user = GetByUsernameAsync → if null throw UnauthorizedAccessException("Invalid username or password."). result = hasher.VerifyHashedPassword(user, user.PasswordHash, dto.Password). If result == Failed throw same exception. Generate token via ITokenService. Return LoginResponseDto { Token, Username=user.Username, Role=user.Role.ToString(), ExpiresAt=DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(settings.ExpiryMinutes) }. Note: PasswordHasher<User> is registered as transient in DI (scoped also fine).

24. Implement DCDSS/Services/PatientService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IPatientService. Constructor(IPatientRepository patientRepo, IPatientAllergyRepository allergyRepo, IUnitOfWork uow). GetPagedAsync: clamp page/pageSize, call patientRepo.SearchAsync, map to PatientSummaryDto list, wrap in PagedResult. GetByIdWithHistoryAsync: call patientRepo.GetByIdWithHistoryAsync → if null return null. Map to PatientDetailDto (allergies as IList<string> from PatientAllergy.Allergen). CreateAsync: validate DOB not > DateOnly.FromDateTime(DateTime.UtcNow) → BusinessRuleException if future. Map to Patient entity, uow.SaveChangesAsync. Then for each allergen in dto.Allergies (trim, deduplicate case-insensitive, skip empty), create PatientAllergy rows, allergyRepo.AddAsync, SaveChangesAsync. Return mapped PatientDetailDto. UpdateAsync: load patient (throw NotFoundException if missing). Update fields. allergyRepo.DeleteByPatientAsync(id). For each allergen in dto.Allergies (trim, dedup, skip empty), create PatientAllergy, allergyRepo.AddAsync. uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return PatientDetailDto.

25. Implement DCDSS/Services/MedicalRecordService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IMedicalRecordService. Constructor(IMedicalRecordRepository recordRepo, IRepository<Patient> patientRepo, IRepository<User> userRepo, IUnitOfWork uow). CreateAsync: load patient via patientRepo.GetByIdAsync → NotFoundException if missing. Load doctor via userRepo.GetByIdAsync → NotFoundException if missing. If doctor.Role != UserRole.Doctor → throw BusinessRuleException("Selected user is not a Doctor."). If dto.VisitDate > DateTime.UtcNow → throw BusinessRuleException("Visit date cannot be in the future."). Create MedicalRecord { PatientId, DoctorId, Diagnosis, TreatmentNotes, VisitDate, Status=Active }. recordRepo.AddAsync, uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return MedicalRecordDto { RecordId, PatientId, DoctorId, DoctorName=doctor.FullName, Diagnosis, TreatmentNotes, VisitDate, Status=Active.ToString(), LabResults=[], Medications=[] }.

26. Implement DCDSS/Services/LabService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements ILabService. Constructor(ILabResultRepository labRepo, IMedicalRecordRepository recordRepo, IUnitOfWork uow, IReferenceRangeParser parser). OrderAsync: load record via recordRepo.GetByIdAsync → NotFoundException if missing. Create LabResult { RecordId, TestName, ReferenceRange, Status=Ordered, OrderedBy=orderedByUserId, DateOrdered=DateTime.UtcNow, ResultValue=null }. labRepo.AddAsync, uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return LabResultDto. UpdateResultAsync: load result → NotFoundException if missing. result.ResultValue = dto.ResultValue. if dto.ReferenceRange not null/empty: result.ReferenceRange = dto.ReferenceRange. result.Status = parser.Classify(result.ResultValue, result.ReferenceRange). uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return LabResultDto. GetByPatientAsync: labRepo.GetByPatientAsync(patientId) → map to IList<LabResultDto>.

27. Implement DCDSS/Services/MedicationService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IMedicationService. Constructor(IMedicationRepository medicationRepo, IMedicalRecordRepository recordRepo, ISafetyCheckService safetyService, IUnitOfWork uow). PrescribeAsync: load record → NotFoundException if missing. Resolve patientId=record.PatientId. Run safety check = safetyService.CheckPrescriptionAsync(patientId, dto.DrugName, excludeMedicationId: null). If !check.Allowed → throw ConflictException with message joining critical conflict messages. DateTime start = dto.StartDate ?? DateTime.UtcNow. If dto.StartDate has value AND dto.StartDate.Value > DateTime.UtcNow → throw BusinessRuleException("Start date cannot be in the future."). Create Medication { RecordId, DrugName, Dosage, Frequency, StartDate=start, Status=Active }. medicationRepo.AddAsync, uow.SaveChangesAsync. Map warnings = check.Conflicts.Where(c => c.Severity != CdsSeverity.Critical) to SafetyWarningDto. Return PrescribeMedicationResponseDto { Medication=mapped MedicationDto, Warnings }. DiscontinueAsync: load medication → NotFoundException if missing. medication.Status = Discontinued. uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return MedicationDto (idempotent — no error if already discontinued).

28. Implement DCDSS/Services/AppointmentService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IAppointmentService. Constructor(IAppointmentRepository apptRepo, IRepository<Patient> patientRepo, IRepository<User> userRepo, IUnitOfWork uow). CreateAsync: load patient → NotFoundException if missing. Load doctor → NotFoundException if missing. If doctor.Role != UserRole.Doctor → BusinessRuleException("Selected user is not a Doctor."). If dto.AppointmentDate <= DateTime.UtcNow → BusinessRuleException("Appointment date must be in the future."). Create Appointment { PatientId, DoctorId, AppointmentDate, Status=Scheduled }. apptRepo.AddAsync, uow.SaveChangesAsync. Return AppointmentDto { AppointmentId, PatientId, DoctorId, AppointmentDate, Status=Scheduled.ToString(), PatientName=$"{patient.FirstName} {patient.Surname}", DoctorName=doctor.FullName }. GetByDoctorAsync: validate doctor exists and is Doctor → BusinessRuleException if not Doctor. Return apptRepo.GetByDoctorAsync(doctorId) → IList<AppointmentDto>.

29. Implement DCDSS/Services/ReportService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IReportService. Constructor(IRepository<MedicalRecord> recordRepo, IRepository<Patient> patientRepo, IRepository<LabResult> labRepo). GetMonthlyStatsAsync: validate month 1-12 and year >=2000 → BusinessRuleException if out of range. totalVisits = recordRepo.Query().Count(mr=>mr.VisitDate.Year==year && mr.VisitDate.Month==month). newPatients = patientRepo.Query().Count(p=>p.CreatedAt.Year==year && p.CreatedAt.Month==month). labTests = labRepo.Query().Count(lr=>lr.DateOrdered.Year==year && lr.DateOrdered.Month==month). deptStats = recordRepo.Query().Include(mr=>mr.Doctor).Where(mr=>mr.VisitDate.Year==year && mr.VisitDate.Month==month).GroupBy(mr=>mr.Doctor.Department ?? "Unassigned").Select(g=>new DepartmentStatDto { Department=g.Key, VisitCount=g.Count() }).ToListAsync(). Return MonthlyStatsDto.

30. Implement DCDSS/Services/AuditLogService.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IAuditLogService. Constructor(IDbContextFactory<DcdssContext> factory, ILogger<AuditLogService> logger). LogAsync: try { using var ctx = await factory.CreateDbContextAsync(); ctx.AuditLogs.Add(new AuditLog { UserId=userId, Action=action, Details=details, Timestamp=DateTime.UtcNow }); await ctx.SaveChangesAsync(); } catch (Exception ex) { logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to write audit log for action {Action}", action); } (swallows persistence errors).

31. Implement DCDSS/Services/AdminSeeder.cs. Namespace DCDSS.Services. Implements IAdminSeeder. Constructor(IUserRepository userRepo, PasswordHasher<User> hasher, IOptions<AdminSeedSettings> settings, ILogger<AdminSeeder> logger, IUnitOfWork uow). SeedAsync: check if any user with Role==Administrator exists via userRepo.Query().AnyAsync(u=>u.Role==UserRole.Administrator). If exists, return (no-op). Resolve password: if settings.Password is null/empty/whitespace → generate random 16-char alphanumeric via RandomNumberGenerator.GetString("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789", 16) (or use RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes approach); log at Warning: $"Seeded initial administrator '{settings.Username}' with generated password '{plainPassword}'. Rotate it immediately.". Else use settings.Password. Hash the password. Create User { Username=settings.Username, PasswordHash=hash, FullName=settings.FullName, Email=settings.Email, Role=UserRole.Administrator, Department=settings.Department, CreatedAt=DateTime.UtcNow }. userRepo.AddAsync, uow.SaveChangesAsync.
acceptance_criteria: All DTO files compile. IAuditableResult is implemented on UserDto, PatientDetailDto, MedicalRecordDto, LabResultDto, MedicationDto, PrescribeMedicationResponseDto, AppointmentDto.
All Models/Cds/ and Models/ files compile.
JwtSettingsValidator rejects empty key, 'REPLACE_ME', and keys < 32 bytes.
